must_refuse.why_it_should_refuse: avoirdupois 28.35 g, troy 31.10 g (fluid ounces are volumes)
US pint, imperial pint, dry pint, and also the typographic point
thermochemical 4.184 J versus International Table 4.1868 J
mechanical 745.70 W versus metric 735.50 W (and electric 746 W)
international mile versus US survey mile (about 3.2 mm per mile apart)
international foot versus US survey foot (2 ppm apart); only matters for geodetic work, listed because the request does not say which
